# ARIS Mechanism Reference

ArenaForge references the public ARIS project for experiment-queue design:

- Project: Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep (ARIS)
- Repository: https://github.com/wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep
- License: MIT

ArenaForge does not copy ARIS source files or Markdown skills. The SSH queue
worker was implemented independently from the documented mechanisms:
manifest expansion, detached execution, persistent state, phase dependencies,
bounded OOM retry, and restart recovery.
